newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Office cleaning should be a career, not black labour.
newsitem.headline: Office cleaning should be a career, not black labour.

text.p: Europe's office cleaning industry urged public authorities on Monday to make changes to ensure cleaning becomes a career rather than being condemned to the black labour market.

Signing the first ever sectoral memorandum on job-creation at European level, employers and unions in the sector said the EU risked losing the cleaning industry's job-creating potential unless it acted.
It said rates and social costs were so ill-adapted to what people could afford that people were obliged to employ cleaners on the black market.

They urged public authorities to give subsidies, tax breaks and reductions in Value Added Tax and for training to make the cleaning industry into a real profession which can be carried out as part of the legal economy, the European Commission said in a statement.
